citas.titulo: Flammable and Explosive Object Detection: A Benchmark Dataset
citas.resumen: The safe management of flammable and explosive objects is critical for preventing industrial accidents. However, there is currently no publicly available dataset dedicated to their automated detection. To address this gap, we present EF-Data as the primary contribution of this work—the first publicly available benchmark dataset dedicated to single-class flammable and explosive object detection, comprising 7102 images and 19,233 annotated instances across diverse industrial, commercial, and residential environments.
